name: Lifting Hands
overview: The act of lifting hands in Scripture symbolizes dependence, worship, and blessing toward the Lord. Moses’ raised hands in Exodus 17:11 demonstrate how lifting hands can be linked to prevailing through God's power. In moments of prayer and supplication, as seen in Psalms 28:2 and Ezra 9:5, lifting hands expresses earnest appeal and humility before God. Additionally, lifting hands is associated with blessing God’s name and meditating on His commandments, as reflected in Psalms 63:4 and 119:48, revealing a posture of reverence and devotion in worship.
